author: Thomas à Kempis
title: That there is no security against temptation in this life

notes.text: (1) Revelation ii. 17. (2) Romans viii. 17. (3) Psalm xci. 15.

verses.text: “My Son, thou art never secure in this life, but thy spiritual armour will always be needful for thee as long as thou livest.
verses.modernizedText: “My Son, you are never secure in this life, but your spiritual armor will always be needful for you as long as you live.

verses.text: Thou dwellest among foes, and art attacked on the right hand and on the left.
verses.modernizedText: You dwell among foes, and are attacked on the right hand and on the left.

verses.text: If therefore thou use not on all sides the shield of patience, thou wilt not remain long unwounded.
verses.modernizedText: If therefore you do not use the shield of patience on all sides, you will not remain long unwounded.

verses.text: Above all, if thou keep not thy heart fixed upon Me with steadfast purpose to bear all things for My sake, thou shalt not be able to bear the fierceness of the attack, nor to attain to the victory of the blessed.
verses.modernizedText: Above all, if you do not keep your heart fixed upon Me with steadfast purpose to bear all things for My sake, you will not be able to bear the fierceness of the attack, or to attain the victory of the blessed.

verses.text: Therefore must thou struggle bravely all thy life through, and put forth a strong hand against those things which oppose thee.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore you must struggle bravely all your life through, and put forth a strong hand against those things which oppose you.

verses.text: For to him that overcometh is the hidden manna given,(1) but great misery is reserved for the slothful.
verses.modernizedText: For to him who overcomes the hidden manna is given,(1) but great misery is reserved for the slothful.

verses.text: “If thou seek rest in this life, how then wilt thou attain unto the rest which is eternal?
verses.modernizedText: “If you seek rest in this life, how then will you attain the rest which is eternal?

verses.text: Set not thyself to attain much rest, but much patience.
verses.modernizedText: Set yourself to attain not much rest, but much patience.

verses.text: Seek the true peace, not in earth but in heaven, not in man nor in any created thing, but in God alone.
verses.modernizedText: Seek the true peace, not on earth but in heaven, not in man or in any created thing, but in God alone.

verses.text: For the love of God thou must willingly undergo all things, whether labours or sorrows, temptations, vexations, anxieties, necessities, infirmities, injuries, gainsayings, rebukes, humiliations, confusions, corrections, despisings; these things help unto virtue, these things prove the scholar of Christ; these things fashion the heavenly crown.
verses.modernizedText: For the love of God you must willingly undergo all things, whether labors or sorrows, temptations, vexations, anxieties, necessities, infirmities, injuries, contradictions, rebukes, humiliations, confusions, corrections, being despised; these things help toward virtue, these things test the scholar of Christ; these things fashion the heavenly crown.

verses.text: I will give thee an eternal reward for short labour, and infinite glory for transient shame.
verses.modernizedText: I will give you an eternal reward for short labor, and infinite glory for transient shame.

verses.text: “Thinkest thou that thou shalt always have spiritual consolations at thy will?
verses.modernizedText: “Do you think that you will always have spiritual consolations at your will?

verses.text: My Saints had never such, but instead thereof manifold griefs, and divers temptations, and heavy desolations.
verses.modernizedText: My Saints never had such, but instead manifold griefs, and various temptations, and heavy desolations.

verses.text: But patiently they bore themselves in all, and trusted in God more than in themselves, knowing that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.(2) Wouldst thou have that immediately which many have hardly attained unto after many tears and hard labours?
verses.modernizedText: But patiently they bore themselves in all, and trusted in God more than in themselves, knowing that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed in us.(2) Would you have immediately that which many have hardly attained after many tears and hard labors?

verses.text: Wait for the Lord, quit thyself like a man and be strong; be not faint-hearted, nor go aside from Me, but constantly devote thy body and soul to the glory of God.
verses.modernizedText: Wait for the Lord, conduct yourself like a man and be strong; do not be fainthearted, or turn aside from Me, but constantly devote your body and soul to the glory of God.

verses.text: I will reward thee plenteously, I will be with thee in trouble.”(3)
verses.modernizedText: I will reward you abundantly, I will be with you in trouble.”(3)
